text:
Taylor Reed: quick round from design sprint — focusing on inline edits for encryption policy, row affordances, and export clarity. uploaded mock: https://redwood.app/figma/encrypt-policy-inline-edit :mag:
Omar Singh: skimmed. main UI smell: inline editor for KMS selection looks like a free text field. make it a controlled select with options: 'Redwood-managed key', 'Customer-managed key (BYOK)', 'No encryption'.
Rina Das: agree on the select. copy nit: instead of 'No encryption' use 'Unencrypted (no key)' to avoid ambiguity for auditors.
Ben Cooper: small accessibility callout — the inline select must expose aria-label like 'Encryption key type for {resourceName}'. also when selection changes, announce via aria-live: 'Encryption set to Customer-managed key for {resourceName}'.
Taylor Reed: good. for destructive changes (switching from customer to no key) show an inline confirmation popover: title 'Remove key for this resource?' with body 'This will make data readable without a key. To comply with org policy, this action may be blocked.' buttons: 'Cancel' / 'Remove'. focus should land on Cancel by default.
Omar Singh: UX detail: show enforcement badges on the row when org policy overrides selection: small lock icon + text 'Enforced (org policy)'. tooltip expands: 'Encryption type enforced by policy: Customer-managed key required.' make the badge keyboard-focusable.
Rina Das: tooltip copy suggestion: 'Customer-managed key (BYOK): key stored in your KMS. Redwood cannot decrypt without key access.' keep under 100 chars. include a link to key management docs.
Ben Cooper: export format suggestion: CSV headers should include both human and canonical fields: 'Resource','Encryption label','kms_type','key_id','policy_enforced'. JSON export should have kms_type enum and policy_enforced boolean to make audits deterministic.
Taylor Reed: style/contrast: current green success for 'Redwood-managed' fails at small sizes. switch to darker fill + white text or add an icon to avoid relying on color alone. ensure contrast >= 4.5:1.
Omar Singh: keyboard flow: when inline popover opens, trap focus and provide aria-modal='true'. also add role='alert' for the removal confirmation result so screenreaders get immediate feedback.
Rina Das: microcopy tweak for audit rows: instead of 'Key present' use 'Key in use: Redwood' or 'Key in use: Customer' — prefix 'Key in use' helps scanning when multiple columns shown.
Ben Cooper: keep a machine-friendly field in the DOM for screen readers and export: data-kms-type attribute with values (redwood|customer|none). frontend tests should assert presence.
preview-bot: preview-upload: encrypt-policy-inline-edit by @Taylor Reed  preview: https://staging.redwood.app/policy/encrypt-inline (expires 48h) :rocket:
Taylor Reed: will update figma with the select states, confirmation copy, and the export header examples. leaving thread open for final microcopy/aria tweaks.
Omar Singh: one last: CSV region column should list canonical codes first, then readable label in parentheses e.g., 'eu-west-1 (EU West)' so scripts can parse reliably.
Rina Das: noted. i'll patch the copy doc and run a quick screenreader pass on the preview build tomorrow. :wave:
